query:
UPDATE contracts
        SET title = COALESCE($1, title),
            s3_key = COALESCE($2, s3_key),
            file_name = COALESCE($3, file_name),
            is_global = COALESCE($4, is_global),
            is_active = COALESCE($5, is_active),
            updated_at = NOW()
        WHERE id = $6 AND deleted_at IS NULL
        RETURNING id
